I replied to Pree in our DM and nowhere else. I told them the possible change to 165 seats for Quarrendon Freight Lines Amendment No. 1 will stay in that conversation. I said I won't mention it in any channel or to anyone else, or save it to shared notes, until they confirm it and ask me to share it.

I searched the shared notes and found nothing on Amendment No. 1 or its seat count. That doesn't prove there's no record, though: the search ran keyword-only. I didn't write anything there, and the rumour isn't stored anywhere.
